_about: Motion tokens. Curves are cubic-bezier control points [x1, y1, x2, y2]. Frames are at 30 fps; scale linearly for other rates. These are craft conventions used as starting points, not measurements: change them per film, and record the change in NOTE.md.

land.use: default arrival of text and panels; most travel early, long quiet tail

landFirm.use: hero or logo arrival from oversize; reads heavy and certain

snap.use: state change in a UI, CTA pieces, near-cut arrivals

glide.use: medium moves that should not call attention to themselves

exit.use: leaving the frame or shrinking away; ends at speed, into a cut

throw.use: hard acceleration into a cut; the next shot inherits the speed

inOut.use: opacity, blur, colour ramps, camera reframes inside a shot

linear.use: drift, creep, counters, anything that must keep living during a hold

lean.use: one small late overshoot (about 5-8 percent); at most once per beat

settle.use: the single visible spring of a film, for a physical payoff
